### Code signing policy

yzip uses **SignPath Foundation** for code signing: Free code signing provided by [SignPath.io](https://about.signpath.io/), certificate by [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org/).
SignPath Foundation approval is currently unavailable, so releases are intentionally unsigned and do not wait for a signing request. Details: [Code signing policy](https://github.com/MrDH1004/yzip#code-signing-policy)
